Acceso (acceso.design)

Purpose:
- Your local design infopoint: a curated directory of local design communities.
- Discover independent design studios, industrial designers, furniture designers, design schools, exhibitions, fairs, design weeks, awards, competitions, manufacturers, workshops, galleries, museums, showrooms, retailers, jobs, and creative opportunities in cities around the world.
- Each city page includes interactive maps, curated listings, and practical information to help explore the local design scene.
- A single place to discover and navigate local design, connect with independent design communities, and research a city's creative ecosystem.

Content structure:
- /designers : directory entry point
- /designers/{slug} : studio/entity pages (primary)
- /designers/in/{place} : location pages (city or country)
- /projects : project gallery index
- /projects/{slug} : individual project pages
- /directory/* : directory listings and detail pages (fairs, museums, universities, awards)

Crawl guidance:
- Prefer canonical, clean URLs without query strings.
- Avoid crawling URLs with query parameters (e.g. /designers?city=...).
- Pages requiring authentication are not indexable.

Sitemaps:
- /sitemap.xml (sitemap index)

Robots:
- /robots.txt

Notes:
- Pages are server-rendered HTML (Astro SSR) and should be accessible without client-side JavaScript.
